purpose: Determine whether the four frozen sampling channels can supply Dataset V1-Core without weakening identity, evidence, source-use, or leakage controls.

official_source_observations.observation: The official site exposes an all-items list view and individual detail pages, but this audit identified no documented bulk file or public data API for the RED list.
official_source_observations.operational_limit: The frozen source contract allows manual or explicit official downloads and does not authorize generic automated detail-page scraping.

official_source_observations.observation: SEC documents the per-filer submissions API and the submissions.zip bulk archive containing filing history for all filers.
official_source_observations.operational_limit: A new versioned bulk-acquisition manifest must preserve the private User-Agent contract, caching, rate limits, immutable bytes, and independent identity review.

official_source_observations.observation: The official tracker exposes complaint narratives and candidate websites, including individual case pages.
official_source_observations.operational_limit: DFPI states that tracker entries are based on consumer complaints and reported losses are not verified; records are candidate seeds only and require independent official corroboration.

official_source_observations.observation: Official HNX/HOSE issuer listings and profiles expose issuer identity, listing status, and in some cases an official website; SSC publishes licensing and securities-business notices.
official_source_observations.operational_limit: Listing, registration, or licensing is identity evidence only. It is not an automatic LEGITIMATE artifact label and does not prove a site was never cloned or compromised.

channel_findings.remaining_gate: Audit Vietnamese and other non-English supply and then select fresh disjoint candidates.
Do not automate RED detail scraping; either obtain an explicit official bulk path or register and terms-review a separate corroborated confirmed channel.
Audit language distribution and preserve clone, compromise, redirect, and impersonation checks.
Use the official submissions.zip universe under a new frozen acquisition protocol and rerun the same strict identity review; do not lower the 0.8 match or 0.15 margin thresholds to inflate capacity.

remediation_plan.action: Freeze an official submissions.zip acquisition and offline crosswalk protocol with immutable raw hashing and the existing private User-Agent protections.
Register and terms-review an HNX/HOSE/SSC issuer-identity channel for Vietnamese legitimate candidates, followed by exact official-domain and archived-artifact review.
Terms-review the DFPI tracker as a candidate-seed channel and require independent official corroboration before any CONFIRMED recommendation.
If DFPI or a Vietnamese exchange channel is adopted, freeze a new matrix version and recompute quotas before enumeration; do not silently substitute channels in V1.

decision.next_gate: Freeze and independently verify the SEC EDGAR bulk-universe protocol plus terms reviews for the DFPI and Vietnamese official-reference alternatives.
